_about: The one size rule for on-screen type (the owner, 2026-10-05: numbers 'the perfect size - not big, not small'; text bold and clean). Each share is the height of the CAPITALS (= the digits) as a share of the FRAME HEIGHT; the font size is share x height / the face's cap height. Read by components/lib/typeKit.tsx and by the worker's tests (tests/test_type_system.py), so the rule has one home.
_dates: The date family (the owner, 2026-10-06: 'when dates are mentioned it barely shows them ... a PERFECT SIZE - not big, not small'): the main date line is a headline (capitals 6 % of the height = a font of 8.2 % of the height, 89 px at 1080p), its kicker 2.5 % (font), the whole block 17-30 % of the frame width, never a full-screen takeover. components/lib/LibKtDates.tsx; tests/test_dates_v2.py checks the numbers.
_rings: A share's ring and a multiplier's ring (the owner, 2026-10-06: 'perfect ones, not full-screen ones'): the diameter 18 % of the frame height (16-20 %), the number inside it, one line of context beside it.
_pack: The look pack (2026-10-07, the owner: 'best quality ones, Premiere Pro / After Effects kind, perfect size'): components/lib/LibKtPack.tsx, LibKtPictures.tsx, LibKtMaps.tsx. Shares of the size unit (the frame height, or a tall frame's 16:9 height) for the CAPITALS, like the roles above; gauge and the cards are shares of the unit / the width. Nothing a viewer must read is under 24 px at 1080p (a share of 0.016). tests/test_look_pack.py checks the numbers.
_pack3: Looks pack 3 (2026-10-08, the owner: 'more animations, better animations ... perfectly quality ones'): components/lib/LibKtPack3.tsx (ranking, waterline, scale, change, streak, alert) and LibKtMaps3.tsx (route, storm track, totals map, states). Shares of the size unit for the CAPITALS like the pack above; the cards as shares of the width (w) and of the unit (h). Nothing a viewer reads under 24 px at 1080p (a share of 0.0162). tests/test_look_pack3.py checks the numbers.
_pack4: Looks pack 4 (2026-10-08, the owner: 'it's not a weather channel tool ... it needs to do everything'): components/lib/LibKtPack4.tsx (price chart, money, table, pros and cons, podium, versus) and LibKtCards4.tsx (profile, steps, cause chain, case file, post, fact check). Shares of the size unit for the CAPITALS like the packs above; the cards as shares of the width (w) and of the unit (h); portrait and stepRing are sizes of shapes, not type. Nothing a viewer reads under 24 px at 1080p (a share of 0.0162). tests/test_look_pack4.py checks the numbers.
